## Checklist
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit, e.g. `fix(web): …` (CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `task test` and `task lint` pass.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in the code, tests or this description.
